snippet.title: Not an NPC Game Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam : store.steampowered.com/app/5212280/Not_an_NPC_Game 

Not an NPC Game is a fast-paced arena game where you don’t attack your opponent directly, you manipulate the arena, trap them, and turn the monsters against them.

Outplay your opponent, survive the chaos, climb the ranked ladder, and prove you’re not an NPC.
